  - [func (s \*FirestoreRegistryStore) Watch(ctx context.Context) (\<\-chan bl.RegistryUpdate, error)](<#FirestoreRegistryStore.Watch>)
- [type InstanceRecord](<#InstanceRecord>)
- [type InstanceStore](<#InstanceStore>)
- [type StoredEvent](<#StoredEvent>)


<a name="Broker"></a>
## type [Broker](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L101-L115>)

Broker is the Google Pub/Sub bl.MessageBroker. Create one with New.

```go
type Broker struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L121>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) (*Broker, error)
```

New connects to Pub/Sub, ensures the jobs and instance\-events topics exist, and starts the timer scheduler. Release its resources with Close.

<a name="Broker.Cancel"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Cancel](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L329>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Cancel(ctx context.Context, req bl.CancelRequest) error
```

Cancel always takes the JobCancel route: Pub/Sub cannot remove a queued message, so there is no pre\-execution queue\-removal path and every cancel requires AllowExternalCancel.

<a name="Broker.Close"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L176>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Close() error
```

Close stops the scheduler and every fetch/subscribe goroutine, flushes pending publishes, and closes the Pub/Sub client. It does not close the RegistryStore, whose lifecycle belongs to the caller. Idempotent.

<a name="Broker.FetchJobs"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [FetchJobs](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L499>)

```go
func (b *Broker) FetchJobs(ctx context.Context, keys []bl.ProcessKey) (<-chan bl.Job, error)
```

FetchJobs yields jobs for the given keys from their per\-key subscriptions. A delivered job stays leased (in\-flight) until a terminal Report\* verb or ReportSuspended acks it; lease extension stops at InFlightTimeout, after which Pub/Sub redelivers.

<a name="Broker.Heartbeat"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Heartbeat](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L440>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Heartbeat(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Heartbeat refreshes the worker's registration TTL.

<a name="Broker.PostError"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostError](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L806>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostError(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, instErr bl.InstanceError) error
```

PostError publishes a non\-terminal error event.

<a name="Broker.PostInputRequest"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostInputRequest](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L817>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostInputRequest(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, req bl.InputRequest) error
```

PostInputRequest publishes a RequestInputTask's request for input.

<a name="Broker.PostNodeCompleted"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostNodeCompleted](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L828>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostNodeCompleted(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, nc bl.NodeCompleted) error
```

PostNodeCompleted publishes a node\-completion event.

<a name="Broker.RegisterProcesses"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [RegisterProcesses](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L415>)

```go
func (b *Broker) RegisterProcesses(ctx context.Context, workerID string, regs []bl.ProcessRegistration) error
```

RegisterProcesses replaces the worker's registration set. WorkerID, RegisteredAt, and LastHeartbeat are stamped store\-side.

<a name="Broker.ReportCancelled"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportCancelled](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L798>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportCancelled(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error
```

ReportCancelled publishes the Cancelled lifecycle event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportCompleted"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportCompleted](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L774>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportCompleted(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, result bl.EvaluationResult) error
```

ReportCompleted publishes the Completed lifecycle event and the Result event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportFailed"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportFailed](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L786>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportFailed(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, instErr bl.InstanceError) error
```

ReportFailed publishes the Failed lifecycle event and the Error event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportRunning"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportRunning](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L742>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportRunning(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error
```

ReportRunning publishes the Running lifecycle event. Does not settle the in\-flight job.

<a name="Broker.ReportSuspended"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportSuspended](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L755>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportSuspended(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, resumeAt *time.Time) error
```

ReportSuspended publishes the Suspended lifecycle event, settles the in\-flight job, and — given a resumeAt — writes the durable timer record the scheduler loop turns into a JobResume.

<a name="Broker.RespondToInputRequest"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [RespondToInputRequest](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L375>)

```go
func (b *Broker) RespondToInputRequest(ctx context.Context, instanceID, requestID string, payload map[string]any) error
```

RespondToInputRequest routes the response to the instance's process key via the last\-event record. An unknown or finished instance surfaces asynchronously on the instance's topic, per the error model.

<a name="Broker.Submit"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Submit](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L261>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Submit(ctx context.Context, req bl.StartRequest) (string, error)
```

Submit validates the request against the live registry, creates the instance's last\-event record, publishes the JobStart, and publishes the Pending lifecycle event.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToInstance"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToInstance](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L949>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (<-chan bl.InstanceEvent, error)
```

SubscribeToInstance creates a per\-subscriber filtered, ordered subscription on the events topic, replays the instance's latest lifecycle (and terminal) event from its last\-event record, then follows the live subscription. The channel closes after the terminal event delivers or when ctx is cancelled; the subscription is deleted on close.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToProcessRegistry"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToProcessRegistry](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L404>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToProcessRegistry(ctx context.Context) (<-chan bl.RegistryUpdate, error)
```

SubscribeToProcessRegistry proxies the RegistryStore's watch feed, which delivers the snapshot, the SnapshotComplete sentinel, then incremental updates until ctx is cancelled.

<a name="Broker.Terminate"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Terminate](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L351>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Terminate(ctx context.Context, req bl.TerminateRequest) error
```

Terminate publishes a JobTerminate. Requires AllowExternalTerminate.

<a name="Broker.Unregister"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Unregister](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L448>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Unregister(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Unregister removes the worker's registrations immediately.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/broker.go#L66-L98>)

Config configures New.

```go
type Config struct {
    ProjectID   string              // GCP project owning the topics/subscriptions
    Credentials *google.Credentials // nil = Application Default Credentials

    // EntityPrefix isolates deployments sharing a project; default "blkit".
    EntityPrefix string

    // Registry is required: worker registry, timers, and instance
    // last-event records. It must also implement InstanceStore
    // (FirestoreRegistryStore does). Its lifecycle belongs to the caller —
    // Close on the broker does not close it.
    Registry bl.RegistryStore

    // Endpoint is a development-only emulator endpoint override
    // (host:port). Production traffic always uses TLS through the SDK.
    Endpoint string

    // Cipher enables end-to-end payload encryption; default nil.
    Cipher bl.PayloadCipher

    // RegistrationTTL is how long registrations outlive their last
    // heartbeat; default 90s (3× the default 30s heartbeat interval).
    RegistrationTTL time.Duration

    // InFlightTimeout bounds how long a delivered, unsettled job stays
    // leased before Pub/Sub redelivers it; default 150s. Values below
    // Pub/Sub's 10s minimum ack deadline are raised to it.
    InFlightTimeout time.Duration

    // EventRetention is how long a finished instance's latest-event record
    // stays replayable to late subscribers; default 1h.
    EventRetention time.Duration
}
```

<a name="FirestoreConfig"></a>
## type [FirestoreConfig](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L71-L98>)

FirestoreConfig configures NewFirestoreRegistryStore.

```go
type FirestoreConfig struct {
    ProjectID   string              // GCP project owning the Firestore database
    DatabaseID  string              // default "(default)"
    Credentials *google.Credentials // nil = Application Default Credentials

    // CollectionPrefix isolates deployments sharing a database; default
    // "blkit". Collections: <prefix>-workers, <prefix>-timers,
    // <prefix>-instances.
    CollectionPrefix string

    // Endpoint is a development-only emulator endpoint override
    // (host:port). Production traffic always uses TLS through the SDK.
    Endpoint string

    // Cipher must match the broker's PayloadCipher: worker registrations
    // are stored envelope-encoded, so the store needs the cipher to decode
    // them for Snapshot/Watch. Default nil.
    Cipher bl.PayloadCipher

    // PollInterval is the Watch/janitor polling interval; default 200ms.
    // Firestore snapshot listeners would push instead, but a polling diff
    // loop keeps the store emulator-proof and dependency-light.
    PollInterval time.Duration

    // EventRetention is how long finished instance records are kept before
    // the janitor deletes them; default 1h.
    EventRetention time.Duration
}
```

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore"></a>
## type [FirestoreRegistryStore](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L105-L112>)

FirestoreRegistryStore implements bl.RegistryStore plus InstanceStore on Cloud Firestore: one document per worker holding its envelope\-encoded registrations and TTL deadline, one document per pending timer, and one last\-event document per instance. TTL expiry is enforced client\-side (reads filter expired documents; a janitor goroutine sweeps them).

```go
type FirestoreRegistryStore struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewFirestoreRegistryStore"></a>
### func [NewFirestoreRegistryStore](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L141>)

```go
func NewFirestoreRegistryStore(cfg FirestoreConfig) (*FirestoreRegistryStore, error)
```

NewFirestoreRegistryStore connects to Firestore and starts the janitor. Release its resources with Close.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.Close"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L171>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) Close() error
```

Close stops the janitor and Watch feeds and closes the Firestore client. Idempotent.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.Delete"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [Delete](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L266>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) Delete(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Delete removes the worker's registrations. An absent or already\-expired worker is unknown.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.DeleteTimer"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [DeleteTimer](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L506>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) DeleteTimer(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error
```

DeleteTimer removes the instance's pending timer, if any.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.DueTimers"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [DueTimers](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L461>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) DueTimers(ctx context.Context, now time.Time) ([]string, error)
```

DueTimers claims and returns every timer due at now. Each claim runs in a Firestore transaction that deletes the document, so concurrent schedulers never double\-fire a timer.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.GetInstance"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [GetInstance](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L558>)


GetInstance returns the instance's record, or (nil, nil) when none exists.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.PutInstance"></a>

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) PutInstance(ctx context.Context, rec InstanceRecord) error
```

PutInstance creates (or replaces) the instance's last\-event record.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.PutRegistrations"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [PutRegistrations](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L197>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) PutRegistrations(ctx context.Context, workerID string, regs []bl.ProcessRegistration, ttl time.Duration) error
```

PutRegistrations replaces the worker's registration set, stamping WorkerID, RegisteredAt (preserved per key across re\-registration) and LastHeartbeat.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.PutTimer"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [PutTimer](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L449>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) PutTimer(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, fireAt time.Time) error
```

PutTimer records a durable "deliver a JobResume at fireAt" entry, replacing any pending timer for the instance.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.Snapshot"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [Snapshot](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L291>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) Snapshot(ctx context.Context) ([]bl.ProcessRegistration, error)
```

Snapshot returns every live (unexpired) registration.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.Touch"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [Touch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L237>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) Touch(ctx context.Context, workerID string, ttl time.Duration) error
```

Touch refreshes the worker's TTL deadline. An absent or already\-expired worker is unknown.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.UpdateInstance"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [UpdateInstance](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L540>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) UpdateInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, latest, terminal *StoredEvent, finished bool) error
```

UpdateInstance merges the supplied fields into the instance's record.

<a name="FirestoreRegistryStore.Watch"></a>
### func (\*FirestoreRegistryStore) [Watch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L308>)

```go
func (s *FirestoreRegistryStore) Watch(ctx context.Context) (<-chan bl.RegistryUpdate, error)
```

Watch polls the workers collection and delivers the full SubscribeToProcessRegistry sequence: one Snapshot update per live registration, a SnapshotComplete sentinel, then incremental Added/Removed/HeartbeatLost diffs. The channel closes when ctx is cancelled or the store is closed.

<a name="InstanceRecord"></a>
## type [InstanceRecord](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L45-L53>)

InstanceRecord is the broker\-coordination record for one process instance: routing metadata and the latest\-event replay data. It never holds process state — that lives in the state store.

```go
type InstanceRecord struct {
    InstanceID     string
    Key            bl.ProcessKey
    CorrelationKey *string
    Latest         *StoredEvent // latest lifecycle event
    Terminal       *StoredEvent // terminal Result/Error event, when finished
    Finished       bool
    UpdatedAt      time.Time
}
```

<a name="InstanceStore"></a>
## type [InstanceStore](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L58-L66>)

InstanceStore is the extension of bl.RegistryStore the Google Pub/Sub broker requires: last\-event records per instance. FirestoreRegistryStore implements it; any bl.RegistryStore handed to Config.Registry must too.

```go
type InstanceStore interface {
    // PutInstance creates (or replaces) the record. Called once at Submit.
    PutInstance(ctx context.Context, rec InstanceRecord) error
    // UpdateInstance merges the supplied fields into the record, creating
    // it if missing. finished is only ever raised, never cleared.
    UpdateInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, latest, terminal *StoredEvent, finished bool) error
    // GetInstance returns the record, or (nil, nil) when none exists.
    GetInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (*InstanceRecord, error)
}
```

<a name="StoredEvent"></a>
## type [StoredEvent](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/google-pubsub/registrystore.go#L37-L40>)

StoredEvent is one envelope\-encoded InstanceEvent kept in an instance record. EventID matches the eventID attribute on the corresponding Pub/Sub message so subscribers can suppress the duplicate live delivery.

```go
type StoredEvent struct {
    EventID string
    Data    []byte // envelope-encoded (and possibly E2E-encrypted) InstanceEvent
}
```

# nats

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/brokers/nats"
```

Package nats is the NATS JetStream message\-broker backend for blkit: subject\-filtered pull consumers carry the job queue, per\-instance subjects in an events stream carry instance events with latest\-event replay, and a JetStream key\-value bucket holds the worker registry. See specs/message\-brokers/nats\-message\-broker.spec.md.

## type [Broker](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L55-L71>)

Broker implements bl.MessageBroker on NATS JetStream.

```go
type Broker struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L93>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) (*Broker, error)
```

New connects to NATS, provisions the jobs stream, the events stream, and the registry / instance\-metadata KV buckets, and starts the TTL sweeper.

<a name="Broker.Cancel"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Cancel](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L549>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Cancel(ctx context.Context, req bl.CancelRequest) error
```

Cancel removes a still\-queued JobStart from the jobs stream (publishing the terminal Cancelled event itself; no opt\-in needed), or publishes a JobCancel when the job was already delivered — which requires AllowExternalCancel.

<a name="Broker.Close"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L187>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Close() error
```

Close stops the sweeper, resume timers, and every consumer and watcher, and closes the NATS connection. Idempotent.

<a name="Broker.FetchJobs"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [FetchJobs](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L1008>)

```go
func (b *Broker) FetchJobs(ctx context.Context, keys []bl.ProcessKey) (<-chan bl.Job, error)
```

FetchJobs consumes the jobs stream through a durable pull consumer filtered to exactly the requested keys, with AckWait = InFlightTimeout. The durable name is derived from the key set, so workers fetching the same keys compete on one consumer and a dead worker's unacked jobs are redelivered to the rest. Delivered jobs are tracked in\-flight per instance until a Report\* verb settles them (ack \+ removal from the stream).

<a name="Broker.Heartbeat"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Heartbeat](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L948>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Heartbeat(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Heartbeat refreshes the worker's registration TTL.

<a name="Broker.PostError"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostError](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L1303>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostError(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, instErr bl.InstanceError) error
```

PostError publishes a non\-terminal error event.

<a name="Broker.PostInputRequest"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostInputRequest](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L1317>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostInputRequest(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, req bl.InputRequest) error
```

PostInputRequest publishes a RequestInputTask's request for input.

<a name="Broker.PostNodeCompleted"></a>

```go

```

PostNodeCompleted publishes a node\-completion event.


RegisterProcesses replaces the worker's registration set and stamps the registry metadata (WorkerID, RegisteredAt preserved per key across re\-registration, LastHeartbeat).

<a name="Broker.ReportSuspended"></a>


ReportSuspended publishes the Suspended lifecycle event, settles the in\-flight job, and — given a resumeAt — schedules the JobResume. The timer is in\-process: a broker restart before the fire\-time loses it (durable timers are pending; see the spec's delayed\-delivery note).


RespondToInputRequest routes the response to the instance's process key. An instance the broker no longer holds surfaces asynchronously on the instance's topic, per the error model.

```go
func (b *Broker) Submit(ctx context.Context, req bl.StartRequest) (string, error)
```

Submit validates the request against the registry bucket, records the instance's routing metadata, publishes the JobStart, and publishes the Pending lifecycle event.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToInstance"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToInstance](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L669>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (<-chan bl.InstanceEvent, error)
```

SubscribeToInstance replays the instance's latest lifecycle event (and the terminal Result/Error event, if finished within retention) from the events stream, then follows live from the next stream sequence with an ordered consumer. An instance with no visible events gets INSTANCE\_NOT\_FOUND as its first event.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToProcessRegistry"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToProcessRegistry](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L799>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToProcessRegistry(ctx context.Context) (<-chan bl.RegistryUpdate, error)
```

SubscribeToProcessRegistry watches the registry bucket: the watcher's initial values become the snapshot (then the SnapshotComplete sentinel), and subsequent puts/tombstones/deletes become Added / Removed / HeartbeatLost updates. Closes on ctx cancellation (or broker Close).

<a name="Broker.Terminate"></a>


Terminate publishes a JobTerminate. Requires AllowExternalTerminate.

<a name="Broker.Unregister"></a>

```go
func (b *Broker) Unregister(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Unregister removes the worker's registrations immediately: a "removed" tombstone put (so watchers see why, with the old registrations attached) followed by the key's deletion.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/nats/broker.go#L28-L52>)

Config holds the construction parameters for the NATS backend.

```go
type Config struct {
    URL         string      // NATS server URL(s); required
    Credentials string      // optional path to a .creds file
    TLS         *tls.Config // nil = plaintext (development)

    // SubjectPrefix isolates deployments sharing a server; it prefixes every
    // subject, stream, and bucket this broker creates. Default "blkit". Must
    // contain only alphanumerics, '-' and '_'.
    SubjectPrefix string

    // Cipher optionally encrypts envelope payloads end to end; default nil.
    Cipher bl.PayloadCipher

    // RegistrationTTL is how long registrations outlive their last heartbeat
    // (default 90s — 3x the default 30s heartbeat interval).
    RegistrationTTL time.Duration

    // InFlightTimeout is how long a delivered job may stay unsettled before
    // JetStream redelivers it (the consumer AckWait; default 150s).
    InFlightTimeout time.Duration

    // EventRetention is how long instance events stay replayable to late
    // subscribers (the events stream MaxAge; default 1h).
    EventRetention time.Duration
}
```

# rabbitmq

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/brokers/rabbitmq"
```

Package rabbitmq implements the blkit MessageBroker against RabbitMQ 3.13\+ (specs/message\-brokers/rabbitmq\-message\-broker.spec.md).

Mapping to primitives:

- Jobs ride quorum queues (one per ProcessKey) behind a topic exchange "\<prefix\>.jobs". Workers consume with manual ack and a bounded prefetch; terminal Report\* verbs and ReportSuspended ack the delivery. A worker whose channel closes has its unacked deliveries requeued by RabbitMQ immediately — that is the redelivery story (no timeout wait).
- Instance events ride a single RabbitMQ stream "\<prefix\>.inst\-events" shared by all instances (retention via x\-max\-age). Subscribers replay the stream from the start to reconstruct the latest lifecycle and terminal events, then follow live, filtering client\-side by the instance id carried in the message headers.
- The worker registry is a heartbeat broadcast on a fanout exchange "\<prefix\>.registry" (RabbitMQ has no KV): RegisterProcesses and Heartbeat publish the worker's full registration set, Unregister an explicit removal, and every broker handle maintains a local cache fed by a private auto\-delete queue, marking workers lost when no broadcast arrives within RegistrationTTL.
- Delayed resume uses the per\-message\-TTL \+ dead\-letter\-exchange pattern: the JobResume is published to a holding queue whose DLX is the jobs exchange, with the instance's routing key.
- Cancel of still\-queued jobs is unsupported natively (AMQP has no selective removal), so Cancel always takes the JobCancel route and the AllowExternalCancel opt\-in applies to every cancel.

FetchJobs consumes the quorum queues for the given keys on a dedicated channel with manual ack and bounded prefetch. <a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/rabbitmq/broker.go#L48-L75>)

Config configures New.

```go
type Config struct {
    // URL is the AMQP URI, e.g. "amqp://user:pass@localhost:5672/".
    URL string

    // TLS enables transport encryption; nil means plaintext (development).
    // With TLS set the connection uses amqps.
    TLS *tls.Config

    // ExchangePrefix isolates deployments sharing a server. Default "blkit".
    ExchangePrefix string

    // Cipher enables optional end-to-end payload encryption. Default nil.
    Cipher bl.PayloadCipher

    // RegistrationTTL is how long registrations outlive their last broadcast
    // before the local cache marks the worker lost. Default 90s.
    RegistrationTTL time.Duration

    // InFlightTimeout is accepted for interface symmetry with the other
    // backends but is not used as a timer: RabbitMQ requeues a worker's
    // unacked deliveries the moment its channel or connection closes, so
    // redelivery is immediate rather than timeout-driven. Default 150s.
    InFlightTimeout time.Duration

    // EventRetention bounds the instance-event stream (x-max-age): how long
    // events stay replayable to late subscribers. Default 1h.
    EventRetention time.Duration
}
```

# redis

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/brokers/redis"
```

Package redis implements bl.MessageBroker against Redis or Valkey (specs/message\-brokers/redis\-message\-broker.spec.md). Only commands present in both servers are used.

Mapping to primitives:

- Jobs: one Stream per ProcessKey (\<prefix\>:jobs:\<encoded key\>) with a single consumer group. Submit and resume timers XADD; workers XREADGROUP; terminal reports and ReportSuspended XACK\+XDEL the delivered entry; an XAUTOCLAIM loop redelivers entries pending longer than the in\-flight timeout.
- Registry: one hash per worker (\<prefix\>:reg:\<workerID\>) holding envelope\-encoded registrations plus a heartbeat\-refreshed deadline; a sweeper detects lapsed deadlines and broadcasts HeartbeatLost on the Pub/Sub feed channel (\<prefix\>:reg\-feed).
- Instance events: one Stream per instance (\<prefix\>:inst:\<id\>, MAXLEN \~ capped) so late subscribers replay the latest lifecycle event and the terminal event; the stream is EXPIREd after the terminal event.
- Delayed resume: a sorted set (\<prefix\>:timers, score = fire time) plus a mover loop that atomically claims due members and XADDs the JobResume.
- Cancel of queued jobs: a Lua script scans the key's stream for the instance's JobStart, checks it is not in the group's pending list, and XDELs it atomically; otherwise Cancel falls through to the JobCancel route.

## type [Broker](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L78-L89>)

Broker is the Redis/Valkey bl.MessageBroker backend. Create one with New; release its connections and goroutines with Close.

```go
type Broker struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L101>)

```go

```

New connects to the Redis/Valkey server and starts the broker's background loops (registry sweeper, timer mover).

<a name="Broker.Cancel"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Cancel](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L381>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Cancel(ctx context.Context, req bl.CancelRequest) error
```

Cancel atomically removes a still\-queued JobStart (publishing the terminal Cancelled event itself — no opt\-in needed), or publishes a JobCancel when a worker already holds the instance — which requires AllowExternalCancel.

<a name="Broker.Close"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L146>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Close() error
```

Close stops the background loops, closes every subscriber and fetch channel, and releases the client. Idempotent.

<a name="Broker.FetchJobs"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [FetchJobs](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L980>)

```go
func (b *Broker) FetchJobs(ctx context.Context, keys []bl.ProcessKey) (<-chan bl.Job, error)
```

FetchJobs yields jobs for the given keys. Delivery leaves the entry in the consumer group's pending list until a Report\* verb settles it; a fetcher that dies loses its pending entries to another fetcher's XAUTOCLAIM loop after the in\-flight timeout.

<a name="Broker.Heartbeat"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Heartbeat](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L785>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Heartbeat(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Heartbeat refreshes the worker's registration deadline.

<a name="Broker.PostError"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostError](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1208>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostError(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, instErr bl.InstanceError) error
```

PostError publishes a non\-terminal error event.

<a name="Broker.PostInputRequest"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostInputRequest](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1216>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostInputRequest(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, req bl.InputRequest) error
```

PostInputRequest publishes a RequestInputTask's request for input.

<a name="Broker.PostNodeCompleted"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [PostNodeCompleted](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1224>)

```go
func (b *Broker) PostNodeCompleted(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, nc bl.NodeCompleted) error
```

PostNodeCompleted publishes a node\-completion event.

<a name="Broker.RegisterProcesses"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [RegisterProcesses](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L725>)

```go
func (b *Broker) RegisterProcesses(ctx context.Context, workerID string, regs []bl.ProcessRegistration) error
```

RegisterProcesses replaces the worker's registration set and stamps registry metadata (WorkerID, LastHeartbeat; RegisteredAt is preserved per key across re\-registration). Changes are broadcast on the feed channel.

<a name="Broker.ReportCancelled"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportCancelled](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1200>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportCancelled(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error
```

ReportCancelled publishes the Cancelled lifecycle event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportCompleted"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportCompleted](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1176>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportCompleted(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, result bl.EvaluationResult) error
```

ReportCompleted publishes the Completed lifecycle event and the Result event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportFailed"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportFailed](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1188>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportFailed(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, instErr bl.InstanceError) error
```

ReportFailed publishes the Failed lifecycle event and the Error event, settles the job, and lets subscriber channels close.

<a name="Broker.ReportRunning"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportRunning](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1141>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportRunning(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error
```

ReportRunning publishes the Running lifecycle event. Does not settle the in\-flight job.

<a name="Broker.ReportSuspended"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [ReportSuspended](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L1154>)

```go
func (b *Broker) ReportSuspended(ctx context.Context, instanceID string, resumeAt *time.Time) error
```

ReportSuspended publishes the Suspended lifecycle event, settles the in\-flight job, and — given a resumeAt — schedules the JobResume via the timers sorted set.

<a name="Broker.RespondToInputRequest"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [RespondToInputRequest](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L449>)

```go
func (b *Broker) RespondToInputRequest(ctx context.Context, instanceID, requestID string, payload map[string]any) error
```

RespondToInputRequest queues a JobRespondToInput for the instance's process key, resolved from the instance's routing metadata. An instance the broker no longer holds surfaces asynchronously as INSTANCE\_NOT\_FOUND (or ALREADY\_FINISHED) on the instance's topic, per the error model.

<a name="Broker.Submit"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Submit](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L316>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Submit(ctx context.Context, req bl.StartRequest) (string, error)
```

Submit validates the request against the live registry (a direct snapshot read — no cold\-start wait is needed because the registry is always current), records the instance's routing metadata, queues a JobStart, and publishes the Pending lifecycle event.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToInstance"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToInstance](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L519>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToInstance(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (<-chan bl.InstanceEvent, error)
```

SubscribeToInstance replays the instance's latest lifecycle event (and the terminal event, if it already finished within the retention window) from the instance's stream, then follows it live. An instance with no visible events gets INSTANCE\_NOT\_FOUND as its first event. The channel closes when the instance finishes or ctx is cancelled.

<a name="Broker.SubscribeToProcessRegistry"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [SubscribeToProcessRegistry](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L670>)

```go
func (b *Broker) SubscribeToProcessRegistry(ctx context.Context) (<-chan bl.RegistryUpdate, error)
```

SubscribeToProcessRegistry snapshots the registry via SCAN, then follows the Pub/Sub feed. The subscription is confirmed before the snapshot is taken so no update between the two is missed.

<a name="Broker.Terminate"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Terminate](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L417>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Terminate(ctx context.Context, req bl.TerminateRequest) error
```

Terminate publishes a JobTerminate. Requires AllowExternalTerminate.

<a name="Broker.Unregister"></a>
### func (\*Broker) [Unregister](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L808>)

```go
func (b *Broker) Unregister(ctx context.Context, workerID string) error
```

Unregister removes the worker's registrations immediately and broadcasts Removed updates.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/brokers/redis/broker.go#L44-L68>)

Config configures New.

```go
type Config struct {
    Addr     string      // e.g. "localhost:6379"
    Username string      // optional (Redis ACLs)
    Password string      // optional
    TLS      *tls.Config // nil = plaintext (development)

    // KeyPrefix isolates deployments sharing a server. Default "blkit".
    KeyPrefix string

    // Cipher enables optional end-to-end payload encryption. Default nil.
    Cipher bl.PayloadCipher

    // RegistrationTTL is how long registrations outlive their last
    // heartbeat. Zero means 90s (3x the default 30s heartbeat interval).
    RegistrationTTL time.Duration

    // InFlightTimeout is how long a delivered job may stay unsettled before
    // it is reclaimed and redelivered. Zero means 150s (5x the default
    // heartbeat interval).
    InFlightTimeout time.Duration

    // EventRetention is how long after an instance finishes its event
    // stream stays replayable to late subscribers. Zero means 1h.
    EventRetention time.Duration
}
```

Generated by [gomarkdoc](<https://github.com/princjef/gomarkdoc>)

# mariadb

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/mariadb"
```

Package mariadb is the MariaDB state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, shareable store keeping each run's ProcessState in MariaDB. It shares the go\-sql\-driver/mysql driver with the MySQL backend but is tuned for MariaDB's own features — INSERT ... RETURNING (10.5\+) and LONGTEXT with a JSON\_VALID check in place of a native JSON type. See specs/state\-stores/mariadb\-state\-store.spec.md.

## Index

- [type Config](<#Config>)
- [type Store](<#Store>)
  - [func New(cfg Config) \*Store](<#New>)

  - [func (s \*Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (\*bl.CurrentVersion, error)](<#Store.CurrentVersion>)
  - [func (s \*Store) Flush(runID string) error](<#Store.Flush>)
  - [func (s \*Store) FullHistory(runID string) (\*bl.FullHistory, error)](<#Store.FullHistory>)
  - [func (s \*Store) Save(meta bl.RunMetadata) error](<#Store.Save>)
  - [func (s \*Store) WriteBatch(ops \[\]bl.WriteOp) error](<#Store.WriteBatch>)


<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mariadb/store.go#L22-L25>)

Config holds the construction parameters for the MariaDB backend.

```go
type Config struct {
    DSN         string // go-sql-driver DSN, e.g. "user:pass@tcp(host:3306)/blkit"; required
    TablePrefix string // table-name prefix; defaults to "blkit_"
}
```

New parses the DSN (forcing ParseTime and UTC so DATETIME(6) columns round\-trip as UTC time.Time values) and opens the pool lazily. Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion returns the latest committed value per (task, field) via a ROW\_NUMBER window (MariaDB 10.2\+). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush is a no\-op beyond confirming the transaction committed: writes are synchronous once WriteBatch returns.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mariadb/store.go#L298>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory returns every stored record for the run in replay order (ts, id). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.


Save upserts the run's metadata.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mariadb/store.go#L157>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops in a single transaction. Inserts use MariaDB's INSERT ... RETURNING (10.5\+) so the stored row id is confirmed in the same round\-trip.

New opens the pool (connections are established lazily; the schema is created on first use). Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config.

### func (\*Store) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L435>)

```go
func (s *Store) Close() error
```

Close closes the connection pool.

<a name="Store.Config"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L430>)

```go
func (s *Store) Config() (map[string]string, error)
```

Config returns the connection details another process needs to reach the same store.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>
### func (\*Store) [CurrentVersion](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L321>)

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion returns the latest committed value per (task, field) via a ROW\_NUMBER window. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Flush](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L280>)

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush is a no\-op beyond confirming the transaction committed: writes are synchronous once WriteBatch returns.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L361>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory returns every stored record for the run in replay order (ts, id). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Save"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Save](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L132>)

```go
func (s *Store) Save(meta bl.RunMetadata) error
```

Save upserts the run's metadata via MERGE.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mssql/store.go#L169>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops in a single transaction, so a task's outputs land together. Concurrent transactions writing the same run can deadlock under SQL Server's locking; the documented remedy is to rerun the victim, so the transaction is retried on deadlock (error 1205) with a small backoff.

# nats

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/nats"
```

Package nats is the NATS JetStream state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, shareable store keeping each run's ProcessState in a JetStream key\-value bucket — a natural fit when NATS is already the message broker. See specs/state\-stores/nats\-state\-store.spec.md.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/nats/store.go#L120>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops one by one — the KV store has no cross\-key batching primitive, which the write contract allows. Each Put waits for the JetStream publish acknowledgement, so an accepted write is already quorum\-accepted and durable — which is why Flush is a no\-op.

# pebble

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/pebble"
```

Package pebble is the Pebble state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, embedded store keeping each run's ProcessState in local files, with balanced read\-and\-write performance. It shares the Badger backend's key scheme. See specs/state\-stores/pebble\-state\-store.spec.md.


# sqlite

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/sqlite"
```

See specs/state\-stores/sqlite\-state\-store.spec.md.

## type [Store](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/sqlite/store.go#L26-L29>)

Store implements bl.StateStore on a SQLite database file. Writes are funnelled through a single\-connection handle (SQLite permits one writer at a time); reads use a separate pooled handle, and WAL mode keeps them flowing while a write is in progress.

```go
type Store struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
```

Flush is a no\-op: the store runs with synchronous(FULL), so every committed transaction is already durable.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/sqlite/store.go#L278>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory returns every stored record for the run in replay order (ts, id). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Save"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Save](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/sqlite/store.go#L122>)

```go
func (s *Store) Save(meta bl.RunMetadata) error
```

Save upserts the run's metadata.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/sqlite/store.go#L148>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops in a single transaction on the writer connection, so a task's outputs land together.

# turso

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/turso"
```

Package turso is the Turso Database state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, embedded store keeping each run's ProcessState in a Turso database file on local disk. Turso Database is the ground\-up rewrite of SQLite in Rust (formerly "Limbo") — in\-process, SQLite\-compatible in query language and file format, and currently in BETA. The driver is pure Go (purego \+ a bundled platform library; no CGO at build time). See specs/state\-stores/turso\-state\-store.spec.md.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L23-L28>)

Config holds the construction parameters for the Turso backend.

```go
type Config struct {
    Path string // path to the database file; required

    // TablePrefix is the table-name prefix; defaults to "blkit_".
    TablePrefix string
}
```

<a name="Store"></a>
## type [Store](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L34-L40>)

Store implements bl.StateStore on a Turso database file. All access is funnelled through a single connection — the engine is in beta, and serialising access through one connection keeps its concurrency surface out of play.

```go
type Store struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L49>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) *Store
```

New opens (creating if needed) the database file and returns the store. Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config or an unopenable file.

<a name="Store.Config"></a>

```go
func (s *Store) Config() (map[string]string, error)
```

Config returns an error: a Turso database file is local to one process on one machine and cannot be shared.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>
### func (\*Store) [CurrentVersion](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L281>)

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion returns the latest committed value per (task, field). The fold is done in Go over a replay\-ordered scan rather than with a window function, staying inside the beta engine's supported SQL surface. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Flush](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L246>)

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush is a no\-op: writes are synchronous once the transaction commits.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L316>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory returns every stored record for the run in replay order (ts, id). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Save"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Save](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/turso/store.go#L140>)

```go
func (s *Store) Save(meta bl.RunMetadata) error
```

Save upserts the run's metadata. The upsert is UPDATE\-then\-INSERT inside a transaction rather than ON CONFLICT — plain UPDATE/INSERT is the most conservative SQLite surface, and the single connection makes it raceless.
